title: Should you let your boss know when you're looking for a new job? 🔎
description:
Should you tell your current company when you are interviewing elsewhere? Generally speaking, definitely not. Even if you really like the company you are at or your boss you always want to keep that ball in your court. You might feel like you should do your current job a favor and give them a heads up but it’s always best to just let them know when your new job is secured. #jobsearchtips #careeradvice #opentowork #remotework
